May 20, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Forbes J M & Co Llp increased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 607.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Forbes J M & Co Llp bought 155,750 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 181,369 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.37 million, up from 25,619 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Forbes J M & Co Llp who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $249.31 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.39% or $1.31 $53.5. About 21.27M shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
